summary: community.hashi_vault now restricts the range of the requests package required by hvac in some cases, due to breaking security changes backported in ansible-core.
questions: Why does community.hashi_vault complain about my requests version?
Which requests versions work with hashi_vault?

answer_card.title: community.hashi_vault narrows requests range
answer_card.answer_md: `community.hashi_vault` now uses a more restrictive **`requests`** version range (needed by `hvac`) in some cases, because of breaking security changes backported into ansible-core. If installs conflict, align your `requests` version with the collection's requirements.
